page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-48-lssd is a virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, it is equipped with 48 dedicated vCPUs and 186.0 GB of system memory, which provides approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration includes 4 local SSDs, although the primary local storage size field is designated as none. This instance does not feature any GPU accelerators, nor does it include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its dedicated CPU allocation, the instance delivers predictable compute performance by avoiding the resource contention typical of shared-core environments. The ratio of memory to vCPUs aligns with standard general-purpose configurations. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of dedicated processing cores and integrated local SSDs offers a balanced resource profile for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance and fast local scratch space without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware.

The c4d-standard-48-lssd is designed for workloads that require a balance of compute power and low-latency local storage. Appropriate applications include hosting medium-sized databases, running continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, serving web traffic, and executing distributed data processing tasks that benefit from multiple dedicated cores and local SSD access.
